audit.why: Both layers read Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger, which matches packet.levelChart row for row, matches the 45.64% win rate, and matches every why-string. The mirror also recorded 'No change' on this point.
audit.corrected: No chart edits. The full-layer why strings were the part still running the generic Lillia script, so those were rewritten to argue their own rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d invents a 'fifteen-second' grenade window, and UPGRADE!!! is described as a permanent turret upgrade.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is 11 seconds FLAT at every rank — not 15, and it never gets shorter, which makes it the most reliable window in the lane. UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70 and, per Riot's text, simply causes his NEXT spell to have increased effects — it is a one-shot empower on a 100-second cooldown, not a standing buff that makes his zone permanent. Micro-Rockets are 11s at rank 1 from 1325 range.
audit.corrected: Eleven-second grenade, 100s UPGRADE!!! described as a next-spell empower, and 1325-range rockets written through the phases, spikes, whys and the interactions block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade is treated as an unavoidable stun on the whole zone.
audit.why: Riot's text is specific: it deals damage to enemy units, STUNS anyone directly hit, and only SLOWS surrounding units. The splash is survivable; the direct hit is not. That distinction is the entire reason a Lillia can cross the turret field at all, and it was missing.
audit.corrected: Direct-hit stun vs splash slow written into report[5], breakdown.cooldowns and early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings say 'Q hop', 'mid-hop' or 'dash in'.
audit.why: Lillia has no dash and no hop. Blooming Blows is a 450-range point-blank AoE whose passive half grants stacking move speed; crossing a turret field means WALKING through it. Telling the reader to dash in and stick Dream Dust describes a champion who does not exist, and it is the difference between committing on a 11-second grenade window and committing on nothing.
audit.corrected: 'Walk in' with the no-dash fact stated in mid, early and whys[2].

audit.why: whys[4] and spikes[2] already state the Dream Dust precondition on Lilting Lullaby ('afflict him with Dream Dust then sleep him'), which the mirror identified as the biggest gap on the Heimerdinger side. It is right on this page. Its 150-second cost was not stated anywhere, so I added it in mid.
audit.corrected: 150s added to mid and breakdown.cooldowns; precondition left as written.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet defect: Heimerdinger's abilities are never properly named — 'H-28G', 'W rockets', 'his turret upgrade'.
audit.why: 'H-28G' is a truncation of H-28 G Evolution Turret, and 'turret upgrade' is not UPGRADE!!! at all.
audit.corrected: H-28 G Evolution Turret, Hextech Micro-Rockets, CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade and UPGRADE!!! all named correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Swirlseed's terrain flag is a tooltip-parsing artefact.
audit.why: Riot's text says the seed rolls until it hits a wall or target; it creates nothing. Worth noting here because a turret counts as a unit the seed can stop on — but the kit file does not confirm that, so I did not write it.
audit.corrected: No terrain claim; the turret-collision question recorded as unverified.

edits.after: Heimerdinger burns CH-2 Grenade on nothing — take the eleven-second invitation.

edits.before: The stun makes his turret nest lethal — dodge it before diving. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: The stun makes his turret nest lethal, but it is 11 seconds flat — dodge it, then you have the whole window.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade (Stun): matchup-defining — The stun makes his turret nest lethal — dodge it before diving. Check it before every step-up. - passive move speed is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade: matchup-defining — 11s flat at 970 range; only a direct hit stuns, the splash just slows. - Your 150s R needs Dream Dust on him first. - You have no dash: move-speed stacks are the whole escape.

edits.after: Track CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade: 11s flat at 970 range. Only a direct hit stuns — the splash just slows. Dodge, then step.

edits.before: Level 1 is dead even — you only have Blooming Blows and he only has one turret, so just last-hit at Q range and don't feed his early CS lead. The moment he hits 2-3 his H-28G turrets carpet the wave and his W rockets start chipping you, and your Dream Dust DoT does nothing if you can't get close enough to apply it. Don't try to walk through the turret field to sweetspot him — you'll eat turret beams plus a W storm and his E CH-2 grenade stun, which locks you mid-hop with no escape button. Farm with the outer edge of Q from max range and accept you're behind.
edits.after: Level 1 is dead even — you only have Blooming Blows and he only has one turret, so last-hit at Q range and don't feed his early CS lead. At 2-3 his H-28 G turrets carpet the wave and Micro-Rockets chip you from 1325, and your Dream Dust does nothing if you cannot get inside 450 to apply it. Don't walk through the turret field to sweetspot him — you'll eat turret beams, a rocket volley, and the CH-2 grenade, which stuns on a direct hit and leaves you with no dash to leave on. Farm with the outer edge of Q from max range and accept you're behind.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your best window in most lanes, but here his zone only gets stronger — full Q rank helps you kite, yet he just resets his turrets and rockets you from behind them. Your one real moment is 6: bait or wait until his E grenade is down, dash in to stick Dream Dust with Q and E, then Lilting Lullaby to sleep him before his turrets shred you. The sleep is delayed and squishy to commit to alone, so it's worth far more with a jungler — sleep him, your jungler dives, and his whole zone evaporates. Solo, just farming even into 6 is a win.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your best window in most lanes, but here his zone only hardens — full Q rank helps you kite, yet he resets turrets and rockets you from 1325 range. Your one real moment is 6: wait until CH-2 is down, 11 seconds flat, then WALK in, because you have no dash, stick Dream Dust with Q or E, and cast Lilting Lullaby before the turrets shred you. That 150-second ult is squishy to commit alone, so it is worth far more with a jungler — sleep him, your jungler dives, the zone evaporates. Solo, farming even into 6 is a win.

notes: No chart edits needed — both layers already agree with each other and with the packet. The two substantive corrections: UPGRADE!!! is a one-shot empower on his NEXT spell (100s at rank 1), not the permanent turret buff two strings described, and the CH-2 grenade stuns only on a DIRECT hit while the splash merely slows — the page treated the whole zone as a stun. I also removed four 'hop/dash in' references; Lillia has no dash and crossing a turret field on foot is the actual problem. Left alone: focus.text reads 'Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade (Stun)'. Trimming it to the correct name would be a >10% length cut on a non-exempt field, so it stays as-is.
